latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Facebook Photo Video Maker: turn photo albums into shareable Facebook videos.
- Supports JPG, PNG, HEIC, and WebP uploads up to 200MB; outputs 1080p MP4 within 30-60 seconds.
- Automatic setup with anonymous token is available; 100 free credits, 7-day expiry for new users.
- Responsive to a wide range of user prompts for uploading, editing, exporting, and checking session or credit status.
- Full cloud GPU processing pipeline delivers fast video rendering and seamless download.
- Job management and error handling with helpful user feedback for file issues, session problems, and rate limits.
